timeline.event: Bronze bell cast by F. Otto, recorded at Amedzofe (DAI survey)

tiers.everyday: German missionaries brought church bells to the Volta Region of Ghana in the 1800s. One at Amedzofe is a bronze bell dated 1855.
tiers.student: The German Archaeological Institute's survey of bells as shared German-Ghanaian heritage records a bronze bell by F. Otto dated 1855 at Amedzofe, alongside an 1857 Pelargus bell at Ho and later steel bells. The FAU project studies colonial-era bells in Ghana.
